empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: A skill is a block of review rules that several agents can share. Create one or import a SKILL.md.

preview.untrustedNotice: This skill was imported. Its body is someone else's instructions inside your agent's prompt — read it before linking it to an agent.
preview.deleteBody: It is unlinked from every agent. This cannot be undone.

editor.subtitle: Text only — a skill can't run code or call tools. Only its text reaches the prompt.
editor.name: Name
editor.descriptionPlaceholder: Use when a PR changes production logic. Flag every branch with no test.
editor.descriptionHint: The description is the skill's interface — write it as a directive: when to apply it and what to check ("Use when…", "Check that…", "Flag…").
editor.bodyHint: Changing the body creates a new skill version.

import.title: Import a skill
import.subtitle: A .md file or a .zip archive with a SKILL.md
import.fileHint: .md or .zip, up to 2 MB. Only SKILL.md is read from an archive.
import.trustTitle: You are importing someone else's instructions
import.trustBody: Once linked, this text goes into your agent's prompt as rules the model follows. Read the whole body before saving.
import.ignoredHint: Not decompressed, not stored, never executed — only the skill text is imported.

detail.select: Select a skill to see its details.

previewTab.title: Preview
previewTab.subtitle: Rendered as the reviewing agent receives it.
previewTab.heading: ### {name}

stats.noAgents: No agent uses this skill yet.
stats.noFindings: No findings from runs that used this skill in the last 30 days.
stats.pullHint: Share of finished runs of linked agents where this skill was in the prompt.
stats.acceptHint: Accepted ÷ (accepted + dismissed) findings from those runs.

versions.title: Version history
versions.subtitle: Every save snapshots the body so eval runs stay reproducible against the exact text they scored.
versions.restoreBody: The body of v{version} becomes a new version. Nothing is deleted — the history keeps every snapshot.

evalsTab.title: Evals are coming soon
evalsTab.body: Run this skill against a golden set of pull requests to see how it scores.

add.title: Add skill
add.prefilled: Review the imported skill, then save it. Nothing has been saved yet.

file.nameHint: Optional — derived from the first heading if blank.
file.descriptionHint: Read from the file's frontmatter — editable before you import.
file.badType: Only .md or .zip files can be imported.

url.hint: Only GitHub-hosted files are fetched (raw.githubusercontent.com, gist.githubusercontent.com, github.com). The text is checked for prompt injection before you save it.
